purpose: Additive post-result chamber development questions; not blind evaluation or replacement of any frozen set.

questions.query: Can a motionless rigid body in initially clear closed Sand occupancy be a valid entrapment result, and does this prove original SOL clearance?
facts: Valid static equilibrium does not require spontaneous escape.
The exact520 geometry fixture is a surrogate through existing workbench ownership, not original native aggregate admission.
Driven penetration and original historical failures remain separate.

questions.query: When does pinned Rapier apply_central_force change velocity relative to native sampling, and how are external drive and response work separated?
facts: The pinned addon applies one immediate Fdt impulse using configured physics cadence.
Measure external API kinetic change before sampling, and response work from live preapplication state.
Endpoint Fdx and a hypothetical second force increment are diagnostics, not additional applied work.

questions.query: Do conserved tuples, a dissipative passive impulse, centre mask clearance or displacement totals prove full-square granular nonpenetration and a valid parcel route?
facts: Counts and exact tuple multisets can coexist with substantial full-square overlap.
Recorded-transform geometry and actual centre masks are distinct observations; endpoints do not certify continuous rotated sweeps.
Displaced totals do not identify parcel routes or admit SOL recovery authority.
